summary: Feed s141_double is degraded: 100% untagged traffic missing required VLANs 10,20 and 21.64 Gbps bursts overload the 10 Gbps APM port (216% capacity).

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is stripping 802.1Q tags or forwarding only untagged traffic - 100% of packets are untagged so required VLANs 10 and 20 never arrive at the APM. Likely broker VLAN stripping / pruning or TAP aggregation misconfiguration.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM cannot segment or filter by VLAN 10,20; application transactions tied to those VLANs are invisible, breaking per-VLAN performance baselines and coverage.

recommended_fix.why: Restore 802.1Q tags for VLANs 10,20 through the broker to the APM so it receives the traffic segments it requires.

findings.root_cause: Aggregate burst rate 21.64 Gbps in 1ms intervals exceeds the APM's 10 Gbps port capacity by 216% (2 overloaded intervals). Single 10G tool port is undersized for peak load from broker.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM ingress buffers overflow and drops packets even though broker shows no drops; results in incomplete flows, missed transactions, and inaccurate latency/error metrics.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute bursts across multiple 10G APM ports/instances via hash-based load balancing to keep per-port utilization below 80% and prevent tool-side drops.
